description: A giant pale statue of a bald man in a long buttoned coat and loose trousers stands on a plinth, gazing up at a dark, stormy sky. Two small dark silhouetted figures stand at its base on the platform, with a dim shoreline and distant hills across the water. The painting is loose and expressive in blue-grey brushwork, with a small white sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner and no frame or border.
